prompt.title: Prompts (World Info)
prompt.mainSub: Text-to-image / Tag generation · artist · vision · system · presets
prompt.modulesHint: Each main prompt can be assigned to modules. Chat injects no preset by default; recreate uses the vision prompt first, then text-to-image and artist prompts.
prompt.genTaskSub: Core instruction that converts descriptions or images into Tags
prompt.qualitySub: Default prefix injected into the system prompt
prompt.systemHint: The system prompt contains the ComfyUI call and iteration protocol. It is generated from API & ComfyUI settings; choose which modules receive it here.
prompt.mainHint: Main prompts combine compiler rules, Tag generation, artist, vision, content policy and matched tag references. Save multiple presets and import or export them independently from World Info.
prompt.worldSub: Select a book · enable or disable it as a whole
prompt.keysPlaceholder: Trigger keywords (space/comma separated; leave blank for constant entries)
prompt.contentPlaceholder: Entry content (the rules injected into prompts)
prompt.noEntries: No entries yet. Click New entry to create one.
prompt.noEntriesExample: Example: keywords "pool beach summer" → inject rules for swimsuit, pool, and wet skin.
prompt.confirmDeleteWorld: Delete world book "{name}" and all entries?
prompt.minWorld: At least one world book must remain
prompt.minPreset: At least one main prompt preset must remain
prompt.importedEntries: Imported {count} entries and set as current
prompt.worldDisabledToast: World book disabled (its prompts are not injected)
prompt.worldNoInject: (This world book is disabled and will not be injected)

promptExtra.worldHint: Enable or disable a whole book before its entries are injected. Entries can use trigger keywords, constant injection, sorting, collapsing and module filters. Import supports this app and SillyTavern World Info JSON; export one book or bundle all books for backup and sharing.
promptExtra.noTrigger: No trigger keywords (active only when constant)
promptExtra.fileHint: File: {name} · {count} entries. Selected entries will be imported as a new world book.

AI_AUTH_401.title: AI authentication failed
AI_AUTH_401.message: The provider rejected your API Key.
AI_AUTH_401.hint: Open API Settings and save the Key again. Make sure the API address, model and account belong to the same provider.

AI_PERMISSION_403.title: AI permission denied
AI_PERMISSION_403.message: This Key cannot access the selected model or endpoint.
AI_PERMISSION_403.hint: Check the model name, account plan, region restrictions and provider permissions.

AI_ENDPOINT_404.title: AI endpoint or model not found
AI_ENDPOINT_404.message: The provider could not find the requested address or model.
AI_ENDPOINT_404.hint: Use the provider base URL and verify the model name.

AI_QUOTA_429.title: AI quota or rate limit reached
AI_QUOTA_429.message: The provider temporarily rejected the request.
AI_QUOTA_429.hint: Try again later and check account balance, quota and concurrency limits.

AI_PROVIDER_5XX.title: AI service temporarily unavailable
AI_PROVIDER_5XX.message: The provider returned an internal server error.
AI_PROVIDER_5XX.hint: Try again later or check the provider status page.

NETWORK_REQUEST.title: Network request failed
NETWORK_REQUEST.message: The application could not reach the target service.
NETWORK_REQUEST.hint: Check your network, API address, proxy and local service status.

REQUEST_CANCELLED.title: Request cancelled
REQUEST_CANCELLED.hint: Start the request again if it was not cancelled intentionally.

REQUEST_TIMEOUT.title: Request timed out
REQUEST_TIMEOUT.message: The service did not respond in time.
REQUEST_TIMEOUT.hint: Check the network and service status, then try again.

AI_CONFIG.title: AI configuration incomplete
AI_CONFIG.message: The API address, model or API Key is missing or invalid.
AI_CONFIG.hint: Open API Settings and check each field.

AI_VISION_INPUT.title: Image processing failed
AI_VISION_INPUT.message: The selected model or image format cannot process this image.
AI_VISION_INPUT.hint: Choose a vision model and check whether the image is valid and not too large.

SECURE_STORAGE.title: Secure storage unavailable
SECURE_STORAGE.message: The system could not securely save the API Key.
SECURE_STORAGE.hint: Restart the app and try again; check user profile and disk permissions if it persists.

AI_ENDPOINT_INVALID.title: Invalid API address
AI_ENDPOINT_INVALID.message: The API address must start with http:// or https://.
AI_ENDPOINT_INVALID.hint: Enter the provider base URL, not the full /chat/completions path.

COMFY_TIMEOUT.title: ComfyUI generation timed out
COMFY_TIMEOUT.message: ComfyUI did not return an image in time.
COMFY_TIMEOUT.hint: Check the queue, model loading and VRAM usage, or reduce iterations.

COMFY_WORKFLOW.title: ComfyUI workflow problem
COMFY_WORKFLOW.message: The workflow format, node parameters or result was unexpected.
COMFY_WORKFLOW.hint: Use an API-format workflow and check prompt, sampler and model nodes.

COMFY_REQUEST.title: ComfyUI request failed
COMFY_REQUEST.message: The application could not communicate with ComfyUI.
COMFY_REQUEST.hint: Make sure ComfyUI is running at the configured local address.

TRANSLATION_LOCAL.title: Local translation failed
TRANSLATION_LOCAL.message: The local translation model did not return a result.
TRANSLATION_LOCAL.hint: Check that models/translation is complete; first load may take longer.

VISION_LOCAL.title: Local image recognition failed
VISION_LOCAL.message: The local vision model could not complete inference.
VISION_LOCAL.hint: Check the models folder, tag table and image format.

DATA_FORMAT.title: Invalid data format
DATA_FORMAT.message: The imported or loaded data could not be recognized.
DATA_FORMAT.hint: Use a supported file format and check that the JSON is complete.

STORAGE_WRITE.title: Local save failed
STORAGE_WRITE.message: Local storage is full or temporarily unavailable.
STORAGE_WRITE.hint: Remove old conversations or images and try again.

LOCALE_INVALID_JSON.title: Invalid language-pack JSON
LOCALE_INVALID_JSON.message: The language pack is not valid JSON.
LOCALE_INVALID_JSON.hint: Use UTF-8 encoding and check JSON syntax.

LOCALE_INVALID.title: Invalid language pack
LOCALE_INVALID.message: Required metadata is missing or unsupported fields were found.
LOCALE_INVALID.hint: Check meta.id, meta.version and the translation fields against the template.

APP_UNKNOWN.title: Operation failed
APP_UNKNOWN.message: The application could not complete this operation.
APP_UNKNOWN.hint: Try again; if it persists, provide the diagnostic code and steps.
